Title: Did I blink? "Unofficial rulings" that I didn'y know about! [LSJ]

Messages.Author: hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
Hiya all,

On the WW website, there is a relatively new download called
"unnoficial rulings" in a handy word document. Niiiiice. However, some
of them were news to me in a big way!

e.g. 1) Perfect Clarity. In the ruling it says that you can still
deflect and redirect an incoming bleed if the bleeding vampire plays
perfect clarity.

e.g. 2) Agaitas / Infernal Pursuit. If this combo applies, opposing
meth does not ditch the additional card, the IP player does.

There are many more. In most cases, no dates or citations are made. I
searched on Google and couldn't find any obvious reference. Where have
these come from? When were they decided?

I'm not disputing the logic behind them, I am just concerned that
these are kind of a big deal (esp the Perfect Clarity, since it is
next to useless at basic otherwise - only Obedience and Internal
Recursion apply).

Help?

DH

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


e.g. 1) is not correct. You cannot deflect a Perfect Clarity acting
vampire. [LSJ 20-JUN-2001] [LSJ 30-AUG-2001]

e.g. 2) is correct. You draw the replacement (singular) for the card
you played from your prey's library (or your own - your choice). You
draw an addition card (for IP's effect) from your own library (no
choice). [LSJ 02-DEC-2001]

As many are wrong as are correct.

In the opening paragraph, it says:
"It hasn’t been proof-read by LSJ, "

I would skip everything in purple. These are quotes
from other people as often as they are from Scott,
and are not guaranteed to not have been fixed by Scott
later in the same thread of the newsgroup.
